en.title: Doing Smart Work
en.description: You may swap adjacent digits of different parity any number of times; find the smallest number you can obtain, with leading zeros allowed.
en.input: The first line contains t; then t lines of digit strings follow. Added by this site: t≤10000, total length ≤200000.
en.output: For each test case, output the smallest digit string on its own line.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Process the operations one by one according to the definition, and watch the boundaries.
